## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen behavior, and any compatibility impact.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] `make test` and `make conformance` pass.
- [ ] Configuration, protocol, security, and operations documentation is updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, sensitive payloads, private endpoints, generated binaries, or transient reports are included.
- [ ] The change preserves deny-by-default tool publication and authorization.
